description: Returns monthly prices for term life insurance from several insurance companies, for a gender, a date of birth, a coverage amount and a term. Health and tobacco use are not part of the request: each option comes back with a low figure and a high figure instead, and the wording that says what they stand for. The four answers go to the agency's life insurance quoting service and to the insurance companies it works with, where the quotes are kept for 24 hours under a placeholder name. No name and no contact details are part of it. A driver's license number or Social Security number is not part of a quote, and a request that carries one is refused. Prices are estimates; nothing is bought.

coverageAmount.description: Coverage amount in whole dollars, in whole thousands.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. Format YYYY-MM-DD. Prices are given for ages 18 to 80.

gender.description: Gender, as the insurance companies record it.

state.description: The state the person lives in. Optional. Prices are for California.

termYears.description: Length of the term in years.

name: get_life_quotes
title: Get term life insurance prices
